question: What claim about the uniqueness of this knowledge is entailed by denying that any equal knowledge exists now or will exist again?
premises: No such equal knowledge exists again.
No such equal knowledge will exist in the future.
inference: This knowledge is presented as without equal, past or future.
uncertainties: The verse does not specify the domain in which this uniqueness holds.
plain_english: There is no knowledge equal to this, nor will there be again.
